About

I'm Noor Haldar, a data engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I've spent the last seven years building batch and streaming pipelines, the last four mostly on Apache Airflow.

I created pipeline-lint after one too many incidents caused by a DAG that looked fine in review and failed at 3 a.m. I write about orchestration and reliability, and I help teams fix flaky pipelines.
